{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for sentinel values: -1, 0, 999, 9999
sentinel_values = [-1, 0, 999, 9999]
sentinel_count = sales_df['customer_age'].isin(sentinel_values).sum()

# Filter out sentinel values
valid_data = sales_df[~sales_df['customer_age'].isin(sentinel_values)]

# Compute mean age on valid data
mean_age = valid_data['customer_age'].mean()

# Print result
print(f"Mean age (excluding sentinel values): {mean_age}")"}
